arxiv-2104-10733.title: Compactness of composition operators on the Bergman spaces of convex domains and analytic discs
arxiv-2104-10733.creator: Timothy G. Clos
arxiv-2104-10733.description: Abstract . We study the compactness of composition operators on the Bergman spaces of certain bounded pseudoconvex domains in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} with non-trivial analytic discs contained in the boundary. As a consequence we characterize that compactness of the composition operator with a continuous symbol (up to the closure) on the Bergman space of the polydisc. 1.

arxiv-2207-13321.title: DynaMarks: Defending Against Deep Learning Model Extraction Using Dynamic Watermarking
arxiv-2207-13321.creator: Abhishek Chakraborty, Daniel Xing, Yuntao Liu, and Ankur Srivastava
arxiv-2207-13321.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Abhishek Chakraborty, Daniel Xing, Yuntao Liu, and Ankur Srivastava. The functionality of a deep learning (DL) model can be stolen via model extraction where an attacker obtains a surrogate model by utilizing the responses from a prediction API of the original model. In this work, we propose a novel watermarking technique called DynaMarks to protect the intellectual property (IP) of DL models against such model extraction attacks in a black-box setting.

arxiv-2301-03491.title: Coderivative-Based Semi-Newton Method in Nonsmooth Difference Programming Thanks: Research of the first author was partially supported by the Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities of Spain and the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) of the European Commission, Grant PGC2018-097960-B
arxiv-2301-03491.creator: Francisco J. Aragón-Artacho, Boris S. Mordukhovich, Pedro Pérez-Aros
arxiv-2301-03491.description: Abstract This paper addresses the study of a new class of nonsmooth optimization problems, where the objective is represented as a difference of two generally nonconvex functions. We propose and develop a novel Newton-type algorithm to solving such problems, which is based on the coderivative generated second-order subdifferential (generalized Hessian) and employs advanced tools of variational analysis.

arxiv-2303-11519.title: Efficient generation of axial magnetic field by multiple laser beams with twisted pointing directions
arxiv-2303-11519.creator: Yin Shi, Alexey Arefiev, Jue Xuan Hao, Jian Zheng
arxiv-2303-11519.description: Abstract Strong laser-driven magnetic fields are crucial for high-energy-density physics and laboratory astrophysics research, but generation of axial multi-kT fields remains a challenge. The difficulty comes from the inability of a conventional linearly polarized laser beam to induce the required azimuthal current or, equivalently, angular momentum (AM). We show that several laser beams can overcome this difficulty.

arxiv-2305-11856.creator: Yunpeng Liu Vasileios Lioutas Jonathan Wilder Lavington Matthew Niedoba Justice Sefas, Setareh Dabiri Dylan Green Xiaoxuan Liang Berend Zwartsenberg Adam Ścibior Frank Wood
arxiv-2305-11856.description: Abstract The development of algorithms that learn multi-agent behavioral models using human demonstrations has led to increasingly realistic simulations in the field of autonomous driving. In general, such models learn to jointly predict trajectories for all controlled agents by exploiting road context information such as drivable lanes obtained from manually annotated high-definition (HD) maps.

arxiv-2512-24072.title: Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana dynamics of magnetized quarkonia
arxiv-2512-24072.creator: Ahmad Jafar Arifi, Kei Suzuki
arxiv-2512-24072.description: Abstract The mass spectrum of hadrons in magnetic fields features avoided level-crossing structures arising from the mixing of spin eigenstates. In this work, we investigate the impact of level-crossing dynamics of charmonia subjected to time-dependent magnetic fields, where we particularly focus on the occupation probabilities of two or more states as they undergo transitions at avoided crossings.

pmc-11590103.title: Insertable Biomaterial-Based Multianalyte Barcode Sensor toward Continuous Monitoring of Glucose and Oxygen
pmc-11590103.creator: Ridhi Pradhan, David Chimene, Brian S. Ko, Artem Goncharov, Aydogan Ozcan, Michael J. McShane
pmc-11590103.description: Chronic diseases, including diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and microvascular complications, contribute significantly to global morbidity and mortality. Current monitoring tools such as glucometers and continuous glucose monitors only measure one analyte; multiplexing technologies offer a promising approach for monitoring multiple biomarkers, enabling the management of comorbidities and providing more comprehensive disease insights.

pmc-13442930.title: Breaking barriers and fighting inequality in Parkinson's disease care: Personal reflections of movement disorders clinicians
pmc-13442930.creator: Shen-Yang Lim, Hrishikesh Kumar, Wei Luo, Jonathan Carr, Zakiyah Aldaajani, Cholpon Shambetova, Priya Jagota, Frandy Susatia, Eliza Zhunusova, Zhidong Cen, Supriyo Choudhury, Saeed Bohlega, Francisco Cardoso
pmc-13442930.description: Parkinson's disease (PD) care remains profoundly unequal across and within countries, despite major advances in understanding and treatment. Drawing on PD specialists’ personal stories of real-world experiences from diverse regions across Asia, Africa, and South America, this paper highlights the key barriers to equitable PD care and identifies pragmatic, scalable solutions.

pmc-13536387.title: Establishment of diagnostic markers for differentiation of oral lichen planus and oral erythroleukoplakia with lichenoid features through a transcriptomic profile analysis
pmc-13536387.creator: Julia Yu Fong Chang, Jung-Tsu Chen, Yi-Ping Wang
pmc-13536387.description: Background/purposeOral lichen planus (OLP) frequently overlaps clinically and histopathologically with oral erythroleukoplakia (OEL), a high-risk oral potentially malignant disorder. OEL with lichenoid features (OEL-L) may closely mimic OLP, resulting in diagnostic uncertainty and inappropriate management. This study aimed to characterize immune and epithelial transcriptomic differences between OLP and OEL-L and to identify potential diagnostic biomarkers.

uslaw-usc-t19-s527.title: 19 U.S.C. § 527 — Sums received from fines and other receipts covered into Treasury
uslaw-usc-t19-s527.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s527.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 3 (The Tariff And Related Provisions); Part 5 (Enforcement Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Except as otherwise provided by law, all sums received from fines, penalties, and forfeitures, connected with the customs, and from fees paid into the Treasury by customs officers, and from storage, cartage, drayage, labor, and services, shall be covered.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2225b.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2225b — Personal service contracts for veterinarians
uslaw-usc-t7-s2225b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2225b.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 55 (Department Of Agriculture). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after October 28, 1991, provisions of law prohibiting or restricting personal services contracts shall not apply to veterinarians employed by the Department to take animal blood samples, test and vaccinate animals, and perform branding and tagging activities on a fee-for-service basis.
